newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Monday that around 3,600 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Friday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 2,400 head were sold at steady prices for steer calves. "Trade active, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 82-92 cents/lb plus a few lots at 95 cents/lb for 300 lb head, and for 400-500 lb head they were between 72-82 cents/lb.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold at firm prices in moderate trade and demand.
Feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were priced at 79-89 cents/lb with instances going up to 90 cents/lb and head weighing 400-500 lb at 68-78 cents/lb.
Through Hidalgo, Texas, around 200 head crossed, although not enough to establish trend prices.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
